newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was at a typical Monday standoff, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fair, and a few bids of $109.00-$110.00 per cwt reported. Seller interest light, as most thinking $112.00 to $113.00. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Confirmed - None Last Week - 900 Last Year - 16,300
For week - 300 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 5,100 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 18,300
